name: Elemental Adept

prerequisites.text: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; your spells of one chosen element ignore Resistance and treat 1s on damage dice as 2s.

benefits.name: Energy Mastery
benefits.summary: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: your spells ignore Resistance to it and its damage 1s become 2s.
benefits.text: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage. Spells you cast ignore Resistance to damage of the chosen type. Also, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2. You can take this feat more than once, but you must choose a different damage type each time.
